implement_android_env_interface: implement a subclass of AndroidEnvInterface that provides action_spec, observation_spec, reset, step, and close methods
get_action_spec: call action_spec on an AndroidEnv instance to get the dictionary of action specifications
get_observation_spec: call observation_spec on an AndroidEnv instance to get the dictionary of observation specifications
reset_episode: call reset on an AndroidEnv instance to reset the current episode and get the initial TimeStep
execute_adb_call: call execute_adb_call with an AdbRequest protobuf to execute an ADB command on the Android device
